arguments.rule_content:
rule Microsoft_WindowsUpdate_DLL {
    meta:
        description = "Detect legitimate Microsoft Windows Update DLLs to prevent false positives"
        author = "SOC Improvement Team"
        date = "2026-04-09"
        hash = "a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2"

        pe.imphash() == "d7b7a4d9c3e2f1a8b6c5d4e3f2a1b0c9" and 
        $signed and $microsoft and $update and 
        pe.number_of_signatures > 0
}

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_DLL {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beacon DLLs via C2 artifacts and known patterns"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1071.001, T1055.012"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike"
        malpedia_version = "20260409"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC BY-NC-SA 4.0"
        confidence = "high"

        $c2_uri_get = "\/stage" wide ascii
        $c2_uri_post = "\/control" wide ascii
        $beacon_config = { 2E 00 63 00 6F 00 6E 00 66 00 69 00 67 00 } // ".config"
        $injection_api = "NtCreateSection" wide ascii
        $useragent = "Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 6.0; Windows NT 5.1; SV1)" wide ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D // PE
        and filesize < 500KB
        and (all of ($c2_*))
        and $beacon_config and $injection_api and $useragent
}

arguments.rule_content:
title: Mass File Encryption - High Entropy with Ransom Note
id: 5a7d9e1f-2b3c-4d5e-6f7a-8b9c0d1e2f3a
description: Detects processes writing multiple high-entropy files AND creating a ransom note file. Reduces false positives from legitimate encryption tools.
status: experimental
author: SOC Team
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
  service: sysmon
  definition: 'Process creation and file creation events'
detection:
  encryption_activity:
    - event_id: 11
      TargetFilename|endswith: 
        - '.aes'
        - '.enc'
        - '.locked'
      FileEntropy|gt: 7.8
      Condition: encryption_count > 5
  ransom_note:
    - event_id: 11
      TargetFilename|endswith: 
        - 'README_FOR_DECRYPT.txt'
        - 'DECRYPT_INSTRUCTIONS.html'
        - '!_RECOVER_FILES_!.rtf'
      Condition: ransom_note_count >= 1
  main_rule:
    Condition: encryption_activity and ransom_note
level: high
falsepositives:
  - 'Legitimate backup encryption (e.g., VeraCrypt, BitLocker)'
  - 'Secure file wiping tools'

arguments.summary: Confirmed compromise of WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.14) via phishing. Adversary executed Cobalt Strike beacon from temp directory, established C2 with 198.51.100.23, attempted Kerberos TGT request, and performed SMB-based lateral movement. Destination IP 10.0.11.77 is a benign Akamai CDN node, not C2.

Initial C2 communication alert triggered by suspicious PowerShell and rundll32 activity on host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.14) was investigated. Analysis revealed that the destination IP 10.0.11.77 is a legitimate Akamai CDN server and not malicious. However, the source host exhibited clear signs of compromise, including execution of encoded PowerShell from Outlook, loading of an unsigned DLL from Temp, and lateral movement attempts via SMB. The true C2 destination was identified as 198.51.100.23, which was blocked at the firewall. The compromised user account CORP\jsmith was reset, and the host was remediated via Ansible playbook.

arguments.summary: Post-exploitation activity detected originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.14) under user CORP\jsmith. A malicious DLL (beacon.dll) was dropped in the user's Temp directory and executed via rundll32, spawned from an encoded PowerShell command launched within Outlook. The payload established C2 communication with 198.51.100.23 over HTTPS, modified the local hosts file for DNS redirection, and attempted lateral movement via SMB and Kerberos. Despite the sandbox classifying the sample as 'limited_threat', SIEM and EDR telemetry confirm active C2 beaconing, credential access attempts, and lateral movement, indicating a high-severity Cobalt Strike operation.
